scenes.headline: Working with JSON
scenes.subtitle: Reading semi-structured and nested JSON data.
scenes.narration: JSON is a flexible, often nested format, and Spark can read it while preserving its nested structure.

scenes.headline: JSON essentials
items: Spark reads newline-delimited JSON by default
Use dot notation to reach nested fields
scenes.narration: Spark reads newline-delimited JSON by default, turning nested objects into struct columns. You reach nested fields with dot notation, and the multiLine option handles pretty-printed JSON that spans several lines.

scenes.headline: Reading and flattening JSON
scenes.narration: We read the JSON events file, and Spark maps the nested user object into a struct column. Using dot notation, we pull out the event id, the user's name, and the deeply nested city field, flattening the structure for analysis.

scenes.text: Reach nested JSON fields with dot notation — no manual parsing required.
scenes.narration: You can reach nested JSON fields directly with dot notation, so there is no need to parse the structure by hand.
